meta.name: bulk-rnaseq
meta.description: End-to-end bulk RNA-seq orchestrator — takes raw FASTQ reads through QC and trimming (FastQC, fastp/Trim Galore), alignment and quantification (STAR, Salmon, featureCounts), assembles a gene-level counts matrix, then hands off to differential expression (pydeseq2), pathway/GSEA enrichment (pathway-enrichment), and publication figures (scientific-visualization). Use whenever the user has bulk RNA-seq reads or quant output and wants a complete, reproducible differential-expression workflow — e.g. "analyze my RNA-seq", "FASTQ to DESeq2", "run nf-core/rnaseq", "STAR/Salmon quantification", "build a counts matrix for DESeq2", or "go from reads to differentially expressed genes and enriched pathways". Routes between an nf-core/rnaseq (Nextflow) path and a standalone STAR/Salmon path, and covers experimental design, strandedness, and QC gates. For single-cell RNA-seq use the scanpy skill instead.

copy.tagline: 分析批量RNA测序数据，获得差异表达基因与通路富集
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果持有批量RNA测序数据，想跑通从质检、比对到差异表达的完整分析流程。
copy.tagline_en: Turn raw RNA-seq reads into differential expression and pathway enrichment results.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have bulk RNA-seq data and want an end-to-end workflow from FASTQ to DE genes and enriched pathways.

howto.what: 它把原始 FASTQ 读段经质控、去接头、比对定量,汇总成基因计数矩阵,再接着做差异表达、通路富集和图表;沿途会核对实验设计与 QC。
howto.when: 当你提到“分析我的 RNA-seq”、“FASTQ 到 DESeq2”等说法,或要跑 nf-core/rnaseq、构建 DESeq2 计数矩阵等任务时接手。单细胞数据改用 scanpy。

say.text: 帮我把这批 FASTQ 一路分析到差异表达基因和富集通路

howto.what_en: It takes raw FASTQ reads through QC, trimming, alignment and quantification into a gene-level counts matrix, then hands off to differential expression, pathway enrichment and figures, checking design and QC along the way.
howto.when_en: Use it when you say things like “analyze my RNA-seq” or “FASTQ to DESeq2”, or want to run nf-core/rnaseq, build a DESeq2 counts matrix, etc. For single-cell data use scanpy.
